negative_true.meaning: ratingChange returned negative = true, signifying eloB's rating should decrease
negative_true.checkpoint: before battleElo applies change and negative

worse_party_rating_before.meaning: rating of the party that performs worse or loses, before battleElo applies the change
worse_party_rating_before.checkpoint: before battleElo applies change and negative

worse_party_rating_after.meaning: rating of the party that performs worse or loses, after battleElo applies the change
worse_party_rating_after.checkpoint: after battleElo applies change and negative

assumptions: battleElo applies change and negative to the internally simulated eloA and eloB scores (a_apply_change).
The worse party's rating corresponds to the eloB score that ratingChange's negative flag governs.

unresolved.description: Report gives no concrete numeric eloA/eloB values or change amount, so the exact magnitude of the worse party's rating increase cannot be bound; only the direction (increase) is formalized.
Report does not state who invokes battleElo or any authorization condition; no caller qualifier can be encoded.

limitations: Only the negative = true branch is formalized for this impact; the negative = false branch (p_negative_false) is not part of this claim.
The relation encodes the direction of the worse party's rating change (must not increase) rather than an exact numeric delta, since no change amount is reported.
Other impacts (v_better_decrease, v_dependent_functions) are handled in separate claim-generation passes and are not covered here.
